To spend every day with a large group of people with diverse interests all tied into holography and their thoughts on the world and how we see things, talking about politics, talking about economics, you know, everybody very much having a very rational standpoint on where we are today in the world. And it's very refreshing to have those conversations. I think if anybody from the symposium or anybody from the holography community in general is seeing this, I really just want to reinforce that. I am very thankful that this still happens. And although things may not always go perfectly as planned, the problem solving skills of the people in that community in the level headedness are incredible. We were able to solve some problems very quickly. It ended up being very serendipitous in the way things happened. And I'm only thankful for how everything played out. I was able to stay in an Airbnb with four other very smart and creative people with diverse skill set. And that led me to kind of sit in the place where I largely felt like I didn't belong among maybe the more technical crowd associated with holograms or holography in general. I was pleasantly surprised to be overwhelmingly welcomed along with the other younger creators on the scene. There's really no putting a price tag on being able to mingle as one very intelligent, very creative, very creative, very creative, very creative, very creative, very very intelligent, and very enthusiastic entity. I don't want to discount not only the emotions that I felt tied to being accepted and heard and understood by these people, again not getting that pleasure very often, along with the overwhelming emotion that I had from just seeing the love and history among the community. Aside from the artwork, aside from holography in general, that was the beautiful treasure that must be preserved. I just wanted to get my thoughts kind of into a screen here. Luckily, you know, I've already been chatting with a lot of the people that were already at the conference, and I'm hoping that we're going to be able to make some really impactful changes when it comes to helping people get into the community as well as nurturing a lot of different ideas that were floating around there. I think that'll be good. I think that's a good little spiel. I don't know if I missed anything. I probably did. As it comes to my presentation, like I said, I kind of rushed it like a high school procrastinator situation, like I am, like I do often, but I'm going to refine a little bit. I'm going to add some things. I'll get that published as well through my channels. Thanks again for everybody at ISDH. It truly was an incredible week. I look forward to the next one.
